mapper.select: SELECT TRUNC(t.create_time) AS itemDate, COUNT(1) AS expressCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.consult_type_name = '特色制剂' AND t2.pay_status = 1 AND t2.pay_flowno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specialCnt FROM powerihsp_outp_drug_master t LEFT JOIN powerihsp_outp_bills_order t1 ON t.order_id = t1.order_id LEFT JOIN powerihsp_register_order t2 ON t.register_order_id = t2.order_id WHERE t.prescription_status = '13' AND t1.is_express IN ('1') AND t.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' AND t.create_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.create_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(t.create_time) ORDER BY itemDate DESC

SELECT ro.dept_code AS deptCode, ro.dept_name AS deptName, ro.doctor_name AS doctorName, ro.close_reason AS closeReason, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.close_reason = '医生长时间不接诊' AND ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 GROUP BY ro.dept_code, ro.dept_name, ro.doctor_name, ro.close_reason ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT ro.dept_code AS deptCode, ro.dept_name AS deptName, ro.doctor_name AS doctorName, ro.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.order_status = '5' AND ro.cancel_reason LIKE '医生未接诊过期订单，系统自动关闭%' AND ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 GROUP BY ro.dept_code, ro.dept_name, ro.doctor_name, ro.cancel_reason ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT a.doctor_code AS doctorCode, a.doctor_name AS doctorName, a.response_duration AS responseDuration, a.sort - 200 AS rankNum FROM powerihsp_doctor_info a WHERE a.sort IS NOT NULL AND a.sort - 200 > 0 ORDER BY a.sort

SELECT COUNT(1) AS cnt, ROUND(SUM((t.examine_time - t.create_time)) * 24 * 60 / COUNT(1), 1) AS avgMinutes FROM powerihsp_outp_drug_master t WHERE t.examine_status = 1 AND t.examine_time IS NOT NULL AND t.create_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.create_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1

SELECT TRUNC(t.create_time) AS itemDate, COUNT(1) AS cnt, ROUND(SUM((t.examine_time - t.create_time)) * 24 * 60 / COUNT(1), 1) AS avgMinutes FROM powerihsp_outp_drug_master t WHERE t.examine_status = 1 AND t.examine_time IS NOT NULL AND t.create_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.create_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(t.create_time) ORDER BY itemDate DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.eval_score < 5 THEN 1 END) AS lowCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.eval_content IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS contentCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.eval_content IS NOT NULL AND t.eval_score < 5 THEN 1 END) AS contentLowCnt FROM powerihsp_consult_eval_record t WHERE t.SATISFACTION_TYPE = '1' AND t.eval_score IS NOT NULL AND t.created_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.created_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1

SELECT TRUNC(t.created_time) AS itemDate, COUNT(1) AS totalCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.eval_score < 5 THEN 1 END) AS lowCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.eval_content IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS contentCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.eval_content IS NOT NULL AND t.eval_score < 5 THEN 1 END) AS contentLowCnt FROM powerihsp_consult_eval_record t WHERE t.SATISFACTION_TYPE = '1' AND t.eval_score IS NOT NULL AND t.created_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.created_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(t.created_time) ORDER BY itemDate DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.DEPART_NAME AS deptName, a.DOCTOR_NAME AS doctorName, a.OUT_CALL_DATE AS outCallDate, b.CREATE_USER AS createUser, b.USER_NAME AS userName, b.CANCEL_REASON AS cancelReason, DECODE(a.SEX, 1, '男', 2, '女') AS sex, a.BIRTHDAY AS birthday, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(NVL(SUBSTR(a.BIRTHDAY, 1, 10), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) / 12) AS age, ROWNUM AS rn FROM powerrsp.rsp_order_info a JOIN powerrsp.public_order_master b ON a.order_id = b.order_id WHERE b.order_back_time IS NOT NULL AND b.cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(b.cancel_reason, ' ') AND b.cancel_reason NOT IN ('自动释放订单', '该号类未进行安排，请联系工作人员', '该预约号源已经挂完!', '接口远程请求军字一号-统一预约平台超时或不可用', '退号数量过大，不可自助挂号，确需就诊请到窗口挂号！', '当前科室下挂号次数超限，请到窗口办理！', '已有该号的挂号记录，不可重复办理', '当日挂号次数超限，请到窗口办理！', '您已挂过该号，不允许重复挂号!||', '该时段已经挂完，请选择其他时段!', '该分时已无序号！', '您已挂过该号，不允许重复挂号!', '该班次已约满！', '该号源已经挂完!', '已经挂完') AND a.out_call_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND a.out_call_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 ORDER BY a.out_call_date ) WHERE rn >= #{startRow} AND rn <= #{endRow}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM powerrsp.rsp_order_info a JOIN powerrsp.public_order_master b ON a.order_id = b.order_id WHERE b.order_back_time IS NOT NULL AND b.cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(b.cancel_reason, ' ') AND b.cancel_reason NOT IN ('自动释放订单', '该号类未进行安排，请联系工作人员', '该预约号源已经挂完!', '接口远程请求军字一号-统一预约平台超时或不可用', '退号数量过大，不可自助挂号，确需就诊请到窗口挂号！', '当前科室下挂号次数超限，请到窗口办理！', '已有该号的挂号记录，不可重复办理', '当日挂号次数超限，请到窗口办理！', '您已挂过该号，不允许重复挂号!||', '该时段已经挂完，请选择其他时段!', '该分时已无序号！', '您已挂过该号，不允许重复挂号!', '该班次已约满！', '该号源已经挂完!', '已经挂完') AND a.out_call_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND a.out_call_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT g.USER_NAME AS userName, g.CREATE_USER AS createUser, t.out_call_date AS outCallDate, t.DOCTOR_NAME AS doctorName, g.LOCK_OPERATOR AS lockOperator, DECODE(t.ADD_SCHEDULER_FLAG, '1', '预约加号', '其他') AS addFlag, g.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, DECODE(g.order_status, '3', '挂号', '5', '退号', '6', '退号') AS orderStatus, ROWNUM AS rn FROM powerrsp.rsp_order_info t JOIN powerrsp.public_order_master g ON g.order_id = t.order_id WHERE t.out_call_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.out_call_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND t.queue_num IS NOT NULL AND g.confirm_operator IS NOT NULL AND g.order_status IN ('5', '6') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM powerrsp.rsp_order_info tt JOIN powerrsp.public_order_master gg ON gg.order_id = tt.order_id WHERE tt.out_call_date >= t.out_call_date AND tt.out_call_date <= ADD_MONTHS(t.out_call_date, 1) AND tt.queue_num IS NOT NULL AND gg.confirm_operator IS NOT NULL AND gg.order_status IN ('3') AND gg.CREATE_USER = g.CREATE_USER ) ORDER BY t.out_call_date DESC ) WHERE rn >= #{startRow} AND rn <= #{endRow}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM powerrsp.rsp_order_info t JOIN powerrsp.public_order_master g ON g.order_id = t.order_id WHERE t.out_call_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.out_call_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND t.queue_num IS NOT NULL AND g.confirm_operator IS NOT NULL AND g.order_status IN ('5', '6') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM powerrsp.rsp_order_info tt JOIN powerrsp.public_order_master gg ON gg.order_id = tt.order_id WHERE tt.out_call_date >= t.out_call_date AND tt.out_call_date <= ADD_MONTHS(t.out_call_date, 1) AND tt.queue_num IS NOT NULL AND gg.confirm_operator IS NOT NULL AND gg.order_status IN ('3') AND gg.CREATE_USER = g.CREATE_USER )

SELECT t.HIS_DEPART_CODE AS deptCode, t.DEPART_NAME AS deptName, DECODE(g.PAY_MODULE, 'before_pay', '先支付', 'after_pay', '后支付', '未付款') AS payType, COUNT(1) AS payCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN g.order_status IN ('5', '6') AND TRUNC(g.ORDER_BACK_TIME) = t.out_call_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returnCnt FROM powerrsp.rsp_order_info t JOIN powerrsp.public_order_master g ON g.order_id = t.order_id WHERE t.out_call_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.out_call_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND t.queue_num IS NOT NULL AND g.confirm_operator IS NOT NULL AND t.HIS_DEPART_CODE IN ('220520', '220550', '222520') AND g.PAY_MODULE IN ('before_pay', 'after_pay') GROUP BY t.HIS_DEPART_CODE, t.DEPART_NAME, g.PAY_MODULE ORDER BY t.HIS_DEPART_CODE, g.PAY_MODULE

SELECT ro.dept_code AS deptCode, ro.dept_name AS deptName, ROUND(AVG((ro.reception_time - ro.create_time) * 24 * 60), 1) AS waitMinutes, ROUND(AVG((NVL(ro.reply_date, ro.valid_time) - ro.reception_time) * 24 * 60), 1) AS receptMinutes FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ro.reception_time IS NOT NULL AND ro.order_status IN (5, 6, 4) GROUP BY ro.dept_code, ro.dept_name ORDER BY waitMinutes DESC

SELECT a.OUT_CALL_DATE AS outCallDate, a.DEPART_CODE AS deptCode, a.DEPART_NAME AS deptName, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM powerrsp.rsp_order_info a JOIN powerrsp.public_order_master b ON a.order_id = b.order_id WHERE a.out_call_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND a.out_call_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND b.order_status IN (3, 4) AND TRUNC(a.create_time) < a.out_call_date GROUP BY a.OUT_CALL_DATE, a.DEPART_CODE, a.DEPART_NAME ORDER BY a.OUT_CALL_DATE DESC, cnt DESC

SELECT a.DEPART_CODE AS deptCode, d.DEPART_NAME AS deptName, a.PAR_ID AS parId, b.doctor_name AS doctorName, a.CREATE_USER AS createUser, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM powerrsp.rsp_recheck_regist_order a LEFT JOIN powerrsp.rsp_doctor_info b ON a.par_id = b.HIS_DOCTOR_CODE LEFT JOIN powerrsp.rsp_department_info d ON a.DEPART_CODE = d.DEPART_CODE WHERE a.PAR_ID != '67390375171764056933972' GROUP BY a.DEPART_CODE, d.DEPART_NAME, a.PAR_ID, b.doctor_name, a.CREATE_USER ORDER BY a.DEPART_CODE, a.PAR_ID
